_comment: Every setting apply can change, with the description and type that each entry of apply's record, app-data/what-apply-changed.json, copies. The section apply's Record, in x1-validator-private-rpc/docs/engineering.md, says how the record works. Not a setting the operator changes.

nginxServiceMasked.description: Whether systemd's nginx.service is masked, so nothing can start nginx.

nginxAptKeyring.description: nginx.org's two pinned signing keys, which apt checks nginx.org's packages with.

nginxAptSource.description: apt's entry for nginx.org's package repository.

nginxAptPin.description: apt's pin, which prefers nginx.org's nginx packages to Ubuntu's.

nginxAccount.description: The nginx account, which nginx's package makes and leaves behind when it's removed.

nginxPackage.description: One of nginx.org's packages: nginx, or its njs or ACME module.

firewallRule.description: ufw's rule that lets https in, on tcp port 443.

hashedApiKeysFolder.description: A folder apply made to hold hashed-api-keys.json, the api keys' hashes and records.

savedPasswordFolder.description: A folder apply made to hold the saved password, or a folder above it.

savedPassword.description: The x1-validator-services password, saved encrypted by systemd-creds, so the tool can read the api keys' records unattended.

nginxFileFolder.description: A folder apply made to hold one of nginx's files, or to hold nginx's log folder.

hashedApiKeysMapFile.description: nginx's list of the api keys' hashes, which apply writes from hashed-api-keys.json.

njsModuleFile.description: The key check, which nginx's njs module runs on each request.

nginxConfigFile.description: nginx's configuration for the private rpc.

systemdDropInFile.description: The drop-in, which has systemd's nginx.service start nginx with the tool's configuration.

nginxLogFolder.description: nginx's log folder, which only root and nginx can open.

acmeStateFolder.description: nginx's folder for its Let's Encrypt account and certificate.

acmeStagingStateFolder.description: nginx's folder for its account and certificate at Let's Encrypt's staging service.

nginxServiceEnabled.description: Whether systemd's nginx.service is enabled, so nginx starts at boot.

startScriptBackup.description: A copy of x1console's start script, saved before apply added --private-rpc.

privateRpcFlag.description: Whether x1console's start script starts the validator with --private-rpc.

gitHook.description: The tool's git hook in x1console's checkout, which runs ensure after an Update X1 Console.

toolTmpFolder.description: The tool's tmp/ folder, which holds ensure's lock.

toolLogsFolder.description: The tool's logs/ folder, which holds ensure's log and the tool's error log.

cronLine.description: A crontab line apply adds: the one that runs ensure every minute, or the one that checks every few hours that nginx holds an api key.
